book.title: Your appointment
book.reschedule: Move the appointment to this time
book.cancelBody: The appointment will be canceled and this link will stop working.

picker.title: Pick a time that suits you
picker.empty: No times are available in this period. Try the next week.
picker.failed: The available times could not be loaded
picker.partial: The remaining days could not be loaded just now. The days shown are available, and you can try again.

errors.taken: This time was just taken. Pick another time.
errors.notAllowed: This can't be done now. The appointment has been refreshed.

invalidLink.title: This appointment link is not valid
invalidLink.body: The link is wrong or has expired. Ask the sender for a new link.

canceled.title: The appointment was canceled
canceled.body: This link no longer works. Ask for a new appointment if you need one.

locked.title: The appointment can't be changed now
locked.body: The time allowed for changes or cancellation has passed. Contact the organizer for help.

awaitsConfirmation.title: Your appointment awaits your confirmation
awaitsConfirmation.body: Confirm the booked time, or pick another time below.

busy.title: The service is busy
busy.body: There are many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

unavailable.title: The appointment could not be loaded
unavailable.body: A temporary problem occurred. Try again shortly.

preset.title: Sector preset
preset.hint: Sets booking values and requester fields together; adjust them in the next two cards.
preset.label: Preset
preset.warning: Applying replaces the values of the next two cards with the preset's own, even when it is the current preset.

booking.title: Booking times
booking.hint: The notice, horizon and length every booking route keeps.
booking.invalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

default_slot_minutes.label: Default slot length (minutes)
default_slot_minutes.hint: New appointment types start with it.

min_notice_hours.label: Minimum notice (hours)
min_notice_hours.hint: A time closer than this cannot be booked.

horizon_days.label: Furthest booking day (days)
horizon_days.hint: A time further out than this cannot be booked.

modification_deadline_hours.label: Modification deadline (hours)
modification_deadline_hours.hint: The change deadline of every appointment type that follows the company, including running bookings, so a raised deadline applies at once. A type with its own deadline keeps it.

link_valid_days_after_end.label: Booking link validity after the end (days)
link_valid_days_after_end.hint: This many days after the appointment ends, the link stops working and answers that the booking does not exist. A booking invited without a time counts from its creation.

requester.title: Requester
requester.hint: What the requester is asked for and may do.
requester.confirmationHint: The appointment waits for the requester to confirm after booking.

form.walkInHint: Records an appointment for someone who arrived without booking.

record.notFound: The appointment does not exist or you cannot read it.
record.confirmTitle: Confirm the appointment? It joins the day schedule.
record.cancelTitle: Cancel the appointment? The requester is told.
record.invitationTitle: Send the appointment invitation to the requester?
